name: Vercel API
tagline: REST API for Vercel deployments, projects, domains, and environment variables
description: The Vercel REST API lets developers programmatically manage deployments, projects, domains, environment variables, and team resources on the Vercel frontend cloud platform. It is the primary programmatic surface for Next.js and other frontend frameworks hosted on Vercel, supporting Git-connected deploys, project configuration, and operational automation via bearer tokens.

auth.details: Bearer token (access token) in Authorization header; create via Vercel dashboard Account Settings > Tokens or OAuth. Team-scoped tokens supported.
